title: onboard-astris-13b-v1.0-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard Astris-13b v1.0 into the model registry and add automated perf-profile and changelog generation. Motivation: Astris-13b is a strong candidate for our mid-tier latency/cost target workloads; onboarding includes validated perf profiles for common sequence length buckets (32/128/512), model metadata (tokenizer, max_length, quantization-recommendations), and an automation hook that appends release notes to the model registry changelog during merge. Changeset includes (1) model metadata YAML and manifest, (2) generated perf profiles and benchmark harness configs, (3) CI job and pipeline step to run perf validation on a small smoke matrix, and (4) a changelog automation script that composes a canonical release note entry and updates registry index. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata (model-metadata/astris-13b-v1.0.yaml) - [x] Include perf profiles for 32/128/512 sequence lengths (perf-profiles/astris-13b-v1.0.json) - [x] Add smoke perf CI job and Dockerfile fixture - [x] Add changelog automation hook and documentation - [x] Add package-level release_notes field to registry index - [x] Run local benchmark verification and attach outputs Context: This PR is the final step from ENG-9142; perf numbers were obtained from the perf-lab using the 1-GPU T4 simulation and validated on a small A100 run for 512 tokens. The automation is intentionally conservative: it only adds changelog entries when perf CI passes and the manifest version is semantically new, and it creates a draft release note requiring a maintainer confirmation. See related work: pr-214999 (automation refactor) and pr-203210 (model onboarding scaffolding).

ci_history_notes: Initial CI run failed on perf-smoke due to flaky network mount; rerun fixed by adding a retry wrapper and pinning docker image digest.
perf_summary: Validated tail-latency and throughput: 32 tokens @ 1200 req/s (p95 45ms), 128 tokens @ 420 req/s (p95 95ms), 512 tokens @ 90 req/s (p95 310ms) on baseline A100 single-instance; recommended quantization: q4_0 for cost-sensitive workloads, fp16 for latency-sensitive deployments.
merge_summary: Merged via squash (maintainer: Ravi Patel). Changelog automation created a draft changelog PR in redwood/changelogs and attached perf artifacts. Manifest version bumped to v1.0 in registry/index.yaml.
release_notes: - Added Astris-13b v1.0 to the model registry with validated perf profiles for seq_len 32/128/512. - Included recommended batch sizes and quantization guidance (q4_0 / fp16). - Added changelog automation to generate draft release notes on merge.
notes_for_ops: Ops: When deploying Astris-13b to Dedicated pools, prefer fp16 for latency SLAs and q4_0 for cost-optimized pools; see perf-profiles/astris-13b-v1.0.json for recommended batch sizes and kernel settings.
